toolbar.fitViewTitle: Zoom and pan to frame the whole drawing

toolHints.drawZone: Click to add points. Double-click or Enter to close.
toolHints.drawRect: Click first corner, then click opposite corner to create a rectangle zone.
toolHints.placeManifold: Click the canvas to place the manifold.
toolHints.measure: Click two points to measure the distance between them. Esc clears the tape.
toolHints.panBackground: Drag anywhere to move the floor plan under your zones. Zones and the manifold stay put.
toolHints.editSpiral: Drag a corner of the zone's spiral to nudge it. Click empty space to finish.
toolHints.routeLeaderActive: Drawing leader path — click to add points (horizontal/vertical only), click the manifold to connect both supply and return, or press Enter to end it here without a manifold. Esc to cancel.
toolHints.routeLeaderIdle: Click a zone to start routing its leaders, or drag a connection dot along the manifold to move it.
toolHints.placeSupplyDeflector: Click to place a supply-air deflector. Stays active, so you can place several in a row.
toolHints.placeExtractDeflector: Click to place an extract-air deflector. Stays active, so you can place several in a row.
toolHints.routeDuctActive: Drawing duct path — click to add points (horizontal/vertical only), click the distribution box to connect it, or press Enter to end it here without a box. Esc to cancel.
toolHints.routeDuctIdle: Click a deflector to start routing its duct.
toolHints.editVentZoneBoundary: Drag a corner to reshape the zone. Click empty space to finish.
toolHints.placeFixture: Click to place a fixture (sink, shower, toilet, ...). Stays active, so you can place several in a row.
toolHints.routePlumbingPipeActive: Drawing pipe path — click to add points at any angle (hold Shift to lock the next point to a horizontal/vertical line), click the water source, sewer connection, another fixture, or an existing pipe to tee onto it, or press Enter to end it here without connecting. Esc to cancel.
toolHints.routePlumbingPipeIdle: Click a fixture to start routing this line.
toolHints.placeDistributionBox: Click the canvas to place the distribution box.
toolHints.placeWaterSource: Click the canvas to place the water source.
toolHints.placeSewerConnection: Click the canvas to place the sewer connection.

calibration.title: Scale Calibration
calibration.description: The drawing is in millimetres, so zones are already true to size. Calibrating resizes the imported plan to match them — measure two points on the plan and give their real distance.

calibration.clickFirstPoint: Click a point on the plan — it stays put as the plan resizes
calibration.clickSecondPoint: Click a second point a known distance away
calibration.enterDistance: Enter the real distance between the points
